{"version":"0.3.28","sequence":30,"url":"https://github.com/nickbyrum2469/tandem-releases/releases/download/v0.3.28/Tandem.exe","sha256":"9da7838eae23311d36233fd002282d2b2573f927485d55be2ae3b64881be288a","size":35912704,"notes":"# Mic threshold
New "Only send my mic when I'm talking" (on): below the threshold your mic is silent, so breathing, keys, fans and friends' voices coming out of your headset don't go out
It stays open a moment after you stop and fades in and out, so words aren't cut and it never sounds choppy
The threshold is set automatically (just above your background noise, and a little higher while a friend talks), or drag the white mark on the mic meter in Voice settings to set it yourself
The mic meter turns green while your mic is on
# Cleaner, less sensitive mics
"Even out my voice level" now boosts at most +12 dB (was +20) and only learns while you're talking
It no longer runs together with automatic volume (the two fought and over-boosted mics); automatic volume is switched off once in its favour
Fixes hearing your own voice back from a friend whose boosted mic picked up their headset
# Headsets
Voices go to your headset's chat side even when Windows numbers the headset ("3- Arctis Pro Wireless Game")","published":"2026-11-22T05:11:08.226634500+00:00"}
